comparison.objective: Use a two-handled rigid bar to push three cartridges flush at their stops.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual rigid-bar grasp and coordinated pushing of three independent loads along lanes.
comparison.success_condition: Cartridge centers finish at x 0.312–0.332 m with spread no greater than 12 mm.
comparison.reason: Shares bimanual force application, but tests simultaneous translational equalization of intact loads, not a stabilized narrow tool receiving impacts to fracture parts.
